verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents alerting on log patterns, counts and attribute values, and lets users create alerts seeded from any dashboard panel. The docs also describe monitoring signals with timely notifications, and alerts can be managed via MCP and Agent Skills. Together this implies alerts across signals, but nothing in the evidence covers notification routing, grouping or silencing. missing for 10: explicit metric/trace alert docs, notification routing rules, alert grouping, silencing/muting/downtime, notification channel integrations, independent corroboration.
